notablePrerequisites: Mirage Mirror on the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rhys, adding {G/W}.
Choose to return Rhys to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rhys from the command zone by paying {G/W}.
Repeat from step 2.
